recognize_zh: 高倍免疫組織化學染色中，許多中至大型淋巴樣細胞的細胞質呈顆粒狀、點狀棕色陽性，核為淡藍色、染色質細緻；標記未標明，型態像細胞毒性顆粒（如 TIA-1、granzyme B）染色，符合傳染性單核球增多症中活化的細胞毒性 T 細胞。
features: Many medium to large lymphoid cells with oval to irregular nuclei and fine chromatin
Brown chromogen in a coarse granular/dot-like cytoplasmic pattern, often perinuclear
Staining intensity varies from scattered fine granules to dense clumps
Hematoxylin-counterstained negative cells intermixed; marker identity not provided
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (antigen not specified) on the splenic lesion shows a dense population of medium to large lymphoid cells with vesicular oval nuclei. A substantial subset shows granular, dot-like cytoplasmic positivity, a pattern characteristic of cytotoxic granule proteins such as TIA-1 or granzyme B, while other cells are negative. Because the marker is not stated, the exact lineage cannot be confirmed from this image alone. In context, the findings are suggestive of an expanded activated cytotoxic T-cell population, as seen in infectious mononucleosis.

ddx.vs: NK/T-cell lymphoma also expresses cytotoxic granules but shows angiocentric necrosis, CD56 positivity and diffuse EBER positivity of the atypical cells rather than scattered EBER-positive immunoblasts.
HSTCL is a monotonous sinusoidal TIA-1-positive, granzyme B-negative gamma-delta T-cell proliferation, not a polymorphous reactive infiltrate.
CD30 gives membranous plus single paranuclear Golgi dot staining, not multiple coarse cytoplasmic granules.
